name: engineering
description: Gaia's spec-driven software delivery lifecycle: intake, architecture, planning, implementation, testing, and release. Provides stage playbooks (architecture documentation, default tech stack, execution planning, engineering delivery, UI engineering, formal testing, and end-to-end process orchestration) plus the specialist agents (intake coordinator, solutions architect, implementation planner, software engineer, tester, release engineer) that take a goal from request to validated, released software through enforced QA and release gates.
